nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances of the binancefarmed token
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used for spend approvals
Private owner address set in constructor; used as trusted address in pooladdress modifier
Public totalSupply of the binancefarmed token, set once in constructor
transfer(address FINANCE, uint _value) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, FINANCE, _value)
transferFrom(address FARM, address FINANCE, uint _value) payable, guarded by pooladdress modifier, performs unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic
approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any guard or SafeMath
Modifier pooladdress(address FARM, address FINANCE) computing the Uniswap-V2 pair and requiring sender/recipient to be owner or that pool
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) deriving the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2-style keccak hash
Payable constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) minting supply to deployer and granting unlimited allowance to UNI router
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller used for ownership, allowance spending and initial mint
allowance[FARM][msg.sender] -= _value performed with native arithmetic, no SafeMath and no explicit overflow/underflow guard
balanceOf[FARM] -= _value performed with native arithmetic guarded only by a require balance check
balanceOf[FINANCE] += _value performed with native arithmetic, unchecked addition that can silently wrap
require(FARM == owner || FINANCE == owner || FARM == liquiditypool) access-control gate inside the pooladdress modifier
Constant internal UNI router address 0x7a25...488D that receives unlimited allowance in the constructor
FINANCE recipient parameter of transfer
_value amount parameter of transfer
FARM source/owner parameter of transferFrom, also used in the modifier access check
FINANCE recipient parameter of transferFrom, also used in the modifier access check
_value amount parameter of transferFrom
_spender parameter of approve
_value parameter of approve
factory parameter of pairFor
tokenA parameter of pairFor
tokenB parameter of pairFor
liquiditypool local variable of the pooladdress modifier holding the computed pair address
token0 local variable in pairFor (lexicographically smaller token)
token1 local variable in pairFor (lexicographically larger token)
pair local variable in pairFor holding the derived pair address

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is consumed inside transferFrom when called directly
FINANCE recipient of transfer is forwarded as the FINANCE argument of transferFrom
_value of transfer is forwarded as the _value argument of transferFrom
transfer internally invokes transferFrom and returns its result
pooladdress modifier is applied to transferFrom and decides whether the call proceeds
pairFor is invoked inside the pooladdress modifier to derive the allowed liquidity pool
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping being decremented with unchecked arithmetic
FARM parameter indexes allowance[FARM][msg.sender] in the unchecked subtraction
_value parameter is subtracted from allowance without SafeMath, allowing underflow
allowance storage mapping is mutated in place by the unchecked subtraction
FARM parameter indexes balanceOf in the unchecked balance decrement
_value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[FARM] with native arithmetic
balanceOf storage mapping is mutated by the unchecked decrement
FINANCE parameter indexes balanceOf in the unchecked balance credit
_value parameter is added to balanceOf[FINANCE] with native arithmetic and may wrap
balanceOf storage mapping is mutated by the unchecked addition
unchecked allowance deduction statement is executed within transferFrom
unchecked balance deduction statement is executed within transferFrom
unchecked balance credit statement is executed within transferFrom
owner storage variable is read by the require inside the pooladdress modifier
FARM parameter is compared against owner in the modifier require
FINANCE parameter is compared against owner in the modifier require
liquiditypool local is compared against FARM to allow transfers involving the pool
the modifier body executes the require that enforces the caller restriction
msg.sender is the owner key written in allowance[msg.sender][_spender] by approve
_spender parameter is used as the spender key in approve
_value parameter is written as the approved amount in approve
approve writes the allowance state mapping for the caller/spender pair
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, defining the trusted address for later checks
constructor sets totalSupply to the supplied _supply
constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender]
msg.sender is captured as owner during construction
the UNI router constant is granted an unlimited (uint(-1)) allowance in the constructor
tokenA is assigned to token0 when tokenA < tokenB in pairFor
tokenB is assigned to token1 in pairFor
token0 is hashed into the pair address computation
token1 is hashed into the pair address computation
factory parameter is encoded into the pair address computation
the pair returned by pairFor is stored in the liquiditypool local of the modifier
pairFor builds the local pair value through keccak256 hashing

normalization_plan.reason: FINANCE is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer and carries no independent identity
_value is the amount argument of transfer and can be folded into the function node
FARM is the source/owner argument of transferFrom and the key of its arithmetic and access checks
FINANCE is the recipient argument of transferFrom and is not an independent state holder
_value is the amount argument of transferFrom consumed by the unchecked arithmetic
_spender only serves as the approval key inside approve
_value only serves as the approved amount inside approve
factory is a fixed input of the pure pair address derivation
tokenA only participates in the ordering/hash computation of pairFor
tokenB only participates in the ordering/hash computation of pairFor
liquiditypool is a short-lived local that immediately feeds the access-control require of the modifier
token0 is a transient ordering local inside pairFor
token1 is a transient ordering local inside pairFor
pair is the return local of pairFor and can be absorbed by the function
